# Earth.Org

> > Earth.Org is a non-profit environmental journalism platform delivering climate action resources, sustainability insights, and community engagement tools.

Earth.Org provides evidence-based environmental reporting covering climate change, pollution, conservation, and sustainable development. The platform includes Movement.Earth.Org, a membership portal connecting individuals to climate action initiatives and community-driven environmental solutions.

## Key Topics

- Climate Action
- Environmental Journalism
- Sustainability
- Water Pollution
- Ecotourism & Sustainable Travel
- Carbon Emissions
- Environmental Conservation
- Climate Communications
- Green Investment
- Non-profit Environmental Advocacy
- Community Engagement
- Tourism Impact
- UN & UNESCO Initiatives
- COVID-19 Environmental Effects

## Community & Membership

- [Movement.Earth.Org - Climate Action Community](https://www.movement.earth.org/): Membership portal for engaging with Earth.Org's climate action community and environmental initiatives

## Environmental Issues & Solutions

- [Water Pollution: Causes and Solutions](https://earth.org/what-are-the-causes-of-water-pollution/): Comprehensive guide to water pollution sources including oil spills, industrial waste, and actionable solutions

## Sustainable Living & Travel

- [What Is Ecotourism and Why It Matters in 2024](https://earth.org/ecotourism/): Guide to ecotourism principles, sustainable travel practices, and reducing carbon emissions from tourism
